findings.message: Entry param page (filter:despesasPendentes, persisted) has no state in the definition. Added the public state page (number | null, persisted) and used it as the page of listarDespesasPendentesEquipe.

rejeitarDespesa needs a typed reason but the definition has no <command>.input state. Added the rejeitarDespesaDraft state (RejeitarDespesaDraft) with setRejeitarDespesaDraft; id and version come from the loaded despesa.
The definition has no member that selects the expense. Added selectDespesa(id | null), which publishes selectedDespesa and calls obterDespesaParaAnalise to fill despesa.

aprovarDespesa and rejeitarDespesa return despesa, which no state has as its source. Applied as the route comments say: the output replaces the despesa state and the row is removed from despesas.items without reloading. The paged totals (page, hasMore) of the queue are not adjusted.
public page is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
